lessons: Historic research decision: US India investment risk volatility limit 25 drawdown limit 25 target return 12 horizon 36 months. The committee produced a research shortlist.

methodology: All sample prices, financial metrics, catalysts and scenarios are synthetic assumptions. Investor-relations links are discovery references and do not substantiate fixture numbers. Sample mode replays the fixed fixture clock, independently of the current date.

Risk uses daily adjusted closing prices: CAGR = (last / first)^(252 / return observations) − 1; annualized volatility = sample standard deviation of simple daily returns × √252; maximum drawdown = maximum peak-to-trough decline.

At least 61 daily closes and dated evidence are required. Live snapshots must be no older than 45 days; sample mode uses the fixed fixture clock. The sample contains 505 closes per security. 252 sessions is a calculation convention, not each exchange’s exact trading calendar.

Hard volatility and drawdown gates use unrounded computed values. Sector exclusions, data quality and live/sample provenance cannot be overridden by commentary. Latest close must match the last adjusted price within 0.1%; contradictory source-ID collisions exclude every affected security and preserve quarantined evidence.

Ranking weights: quality 30%, risk headroom 25%, growth and margins 20%, valuation heuristic 15%, historical aspiration comparison 10%, followed by explicit skeptic penalties. Scores are relative research priorities, not probabilities.
A horizon of 12 months or less makes otherwise eligible equities watch-only. Conflicting return/risk preferences trigger abstention under an explicit product policy, not a modeled efficient frontier.

Returns are local-currency price returns; dividends, withholding, fees, FX, taxes, market access, liquidity and portfolio correlations are not modeled. No portfolio optimization or order execution is provided.
Stress scenarios apply stated hypothetical shocks. Historical maximum drawdown is an observation, never a stop-loss guarantee or a bound on future losses.
warnings: Synthetic demonstration dataset. Prices, fundamentals, returns, catalysts and scenarios are fabricated assumptions; they are not current or historical market observations. Company names identify research examples only. Source links are discovery references, not evidence for the fabricated numbers. Sample validation replays the fixed 2026-10-23 fixture clock; the run creation time is not a current market-data timestamp.

Returns and risk are in each security’s listing currency. They are not normalized to AED; FX, taxes, access restrictions, fees and investability require separate verification. Capital is not converted into share allocations.
The shortest supplied price history spans about 2 years, shorter than your 60-month horizon; it cannot establish performance across that full horizon.
